items.title: An environment-pipeline design (game lifecycle, state ownership, recovery, throughput) is recorded as an ADR from a scout map and an architecture review, before any refactor is implemented
items.body: Developer direction 2026-09-30: map first (scout), then an architecture specialist designs, then implement. Goals: robustness (single owner of game state, the world-held invariant, one recovery path, snapshots allowed) and throughput (emulator RAM/cores/rendering, bridge overhead). The #95 targeted fix lands independently first. Refs #95

comments.text: Scout map done (reported inline; no file written). Key facts: the bridge steps ONE rendered frame per iteration (frame_game_ms 100) and is ~96.5% of wall time. Render-interval 16 gave 1.8x game-time speed but only 1.06x decisions/h. 7 actors is VRAM-bound. Hold/sequence state is duplicated in 5 places. An instance that fails bring-up is skipped by teardown (M1B-E029, unfixed). C++/Python constants are synced only through comments. The handoff doc is stale (2026-09-19). An architecture specialist is now designing (state owner, structural world-held, snapshot recovery vs death path, throughput levers, migration plan) and may query the scout.

Architecture design received (session scratchpad p98/design.md). Five root weaknesses: 1) the world hold is a convention between layers, not a bridge guarantee; 2) no instance recovery, and retirement has no bound; 3) failures are carried as free text and flattened; 4) C++ and Python constants are synced only by comments; 5) no owner for off-process resources. Proposed: the bridge reports lifecycle+held and enforces the hold (EnsureHeld) after every command; the adapter mirror is deleted; one typed error table; recovery = death path, else a cold -read-only relaunch; snapshots rejected on evidence (-gpu host can't save Vulkan snapshots, lavapipe too slow). Throughput: ~55 ms per decision outside the advance is unattributed; running learning on the actor thread blocks the other actors. Packages P1 classification, P2 resources, P3 relaunch, M1 fixed-policy benchmark, P4 bridge hold, then T1-T5. Awaiting the user's decisions before the ADR.

User delegated both decisions to the lead. Decided: (1) a cold -read-only relaunch is accepted as golden recovery; this needs an ADR and a matching AGENTS.md/task.md wording change, with no weakening of the requirement. (2) Gate 0: a short 7-actor check run after the #95 landing. If it is clean (no stale/WORLD_NOT_HELD cascades, no dead games), launch M3-P016 and build P1-P3 during the run. Otherwise P3 (relaunch) goes before M3-P016.
Done-condition met: ADR 0016 recorded (5aa5ded). Unbuilt packages P1/P3/P4 get their own items. Board audit #125.

comments.text: Diagnosis recorded in ff440d3, with every number re-measured. Not undertraining. items.title: A reward design derived from game mechanics and RL practice (candidates ranked, recommended formula, required bridge fields, validation experiment) is presented to the developer and, if adopted, recorded as an ADR

comments.text: Reward design delivered. Waves are timer-driven (35.0 s median; 99.97% in [34.5, 35.6] over 30,266 waves), so waves-as-reward equals survival time at coarser resolution. There is no internal score. Recommended as a test only: health-potential shaping r~ = (1-d)V_REF + dΦ(s') - Φ(s), Φ = 0.1·V_REF·health_fraction, Φ(terminal) = 0; it needs no bridge field. The developer's hypothesis (γ 0.999 adds noise) is contradicted on noise: M3-P015 had lower |TD| and gradient norm and a better value fit than M3-P014, but the performance gap is confounded (6 actors, 67-79% valid). Keep 0.999. Awaiting the developer's decision.
Delivered, not adopted: developer cancelled reward shaping (2026-10-01); discount set by ADR 0019 (362321c). Board audit #125.

items.title: Reward research phase: a literature-grounded shortlist of 3-4 reward designs is pre-registered and compared at ~100k decisions per arm with enough seeds to detect a pre-stated effect, and the result names the reward for the next full run

comments.text: Literature review and study design received (scratchpad reward-study/). The survival reward already is the objective, and proxy rewards are ruled out. Shortlist: C0 control; C1 health potential Φ = 2.5h; C2 Φ = 1.7h + 2.5·clip(margin, 0, 1.5). DQN only. 100k per arm total cannot discriminate (MDE > 15 waves). Design: 100k per seed, 4 blocks × 3 arms in stage 1 (~13 h), up to 8 seeds (~26 h), Holm-corrected paired CIs. Offline O1/O2 first. Caveat: the γ 0.999 control sat at ~31 at 100k vs 43 at 0.997, so the discount may matter more than the reward. Waiting on the #109 DQN audit before pre-registering.
Developer decisions: no discount comparison (γ stays 0.999, the protocol value); focus stays on DreamerV3; the reward study waits for the Dreamer conventions fix (#108).

P017 diagnosis points here: learner now official, plateau persists; cause is credit (survival reward gives no per-decision purchase signal). Design (scratchpad reward-study/design.md) was on stacked-dqn, now deleted — must be re-based on DreamerV3. Open with developer: 100k multi-seed pilot (sample efficiency, ~15 device-h) vs a long C2 run against the two existing controls (tests the plateau).

Developer chose B: one long DreamerV3 run with C2 shaping (Phi = 1.7h + 2.5 clip(m,0,1.5), Phi(terminal)=0) as M3-P018, against controls P016 a1 (best 43.09), a3 (36.34), P017 (~30). Bar to be pre-registered before launch. Shaping engineer dispatched on branch shaping (CPU only). Launch prerequisites: shaping landed + Tier C review, #112 early-deflation fix, r2d2 landed or explicitly excluded.
Developer revised: no defense bonus. M3-P018 arm is C1 health-only shaping, Phi = 2.5h, Phi(terminal)=0. Engineer redirected; no C2 code.
Developer cancelled shaping (no health, no defense bonus). Shaping engineer stopped; branch shaping not to land. Reward next step open.
Retired: shaping cancelled 2026-10-01; later work went to discount (ADR 0019, 362321c) and scripted builds (#120-#122). Reopen as a new item if reward work returns. Board audit #125.

items.title: An audit lists every deviation of stacked-dqn from its reference recipes (R2D2, Ape-X, BBF/SR-SPR and others it cites), classifying each as protocol-required, deliberate with evidence, or a mistake to fix

comments.text: Audit done: 41 rows. Counts: a 13, b 6, c 6, c* (deliberate but never measured) 6, d 8, e 2. Mistakes to fix: (1) window stride hard-coded at 40 overlaps learning spans (1.6-1.75x reuse), under-samples the first 40 decisions, and the window tail gets no target where R2D2 shortens n; (2) gradient clip 10 has no derivation and binds (p90 10-15); (3) priority mean counts no-target steps; (4) weight decay 1e-5 is a no-op; (5) a failed-episode window drops its valid steps; (6) reset target copies the online network instead of re-initialising. No zero-start equivalent: burn-in 7 fills the window exactly. The history-window vs LSTM ablation was never run. Resets: keep until #96 measures them.

Close-out via #111 rebuild: of 41 audit rows, 25 resolved, 9 moot by deletion of stacked-dqn, 7 remain, all forced by environment/protocol (listed in solution §9.4 conventions table on branch r2d2). Close when r2d2 lands.

items.title: Early-episode game_time_deflated (wave 1-2, ratio 0.95-0.99 on the first 2,000 ms) is explained by a device measurement and either fixed at its cause or shown to be a real deflated world
items.body: M3-P017 resume 2: 6+ wave-1 game_time_deflated invalids (0.947-0.989x) after the round-clock correction (cef84b2). Round-clock probe found 2-frame losses on slow advances (230-312 ms wall), 0.16% of advances; judged on only the first 2,000 ms evidence these fail an episode at wave 1. Also open: bridge_event_divergence and mask_legal_purchase_rejected/precondition_failed recurring. Evidence: scratchpad m3-p017/probe/, invalids.md.

comments.text: Dispatched to engineer: device clockprobe of early advances (30+ episode starts), fix the accounting/cause without weakening the 0.99 floor or 2,000 ms window; bridge change requires fingerprint and lead decision before landing. M3-P017 seg 3: 16/717 wave-1 deflations (0.947-0.989x). Also: summary.json valid_episodes 684 vs 686 from lines.

Explained by device measurement (3 actors x 12 eps, 29,427 advances). 0.33% of advances count one frame the round clock never credits: Pause lands inside a slow frame's dispatch (rate rises with frame duration; host load). Every simulated frame credits exactly 107 ms, so the world's rate is correct. Only wave 1 fails because one 107 ms frame is >1% of under ~10.7 s of evidence. Host fix: PAUSE_RACE_FRAME_ALLOWANCE=1 frame; floor 0.99, ceiling 1.25, 2,000 ms minimum unchanged; a 3%-short world still fails within ~5.4 s. Lead accepts this as a measurement correction, not a relaxed validator (the counted frame was never simulated). Cost: a 0.989x world is now caught at ~107 s, not ~11 s. Production bridge unchanged (33d7ada0); diagnostics-only probe fields in source. Landed c20f245; pytest 1345 / ruff 0 / mypy 0. summary.json 717 vs 686: 2 failed starts counted as episodes; not a bug.

items.title: M3-P018: DreamerV3 at γ 0.997 per game-second, otherwise identical to M3-P017, is pre-registered, run under its stop rules, and recorded with a verdict on whether the discount explains the plateau (bar: two consecutive period means > 43.09)
items.body: Developer decision 2026-10-01: discount comparison. Controls at 0.999: P016 a1 best 43.09, a3 36.34, P017 38.05. ADR 0013 predicted 0.997 keeps <=26% of optimal SNR; DQN evidence (P014 55.7 at 0.997 vs P015b ~31 at 0.999) contradicts. Prereqs: #112 landed, r2d2 (#111) landed. 500k rule (best < 39.4) applies. n=1 detects only large effects.

comments.text: Pre-registered dbcb8e0. Launched 07:02Z: state/runs/m3-p018-dreamerv3-g0997-20261001T070256Z, scope m3-p018-20261001T070256Z, 7/7 ready, 29 episodes 0 invalid, manifest γ 0.997. Recorded confound: the survival reward per game-second scales with the horizon, so P018 changes both horizon and reward scale. DreamerV3's return normalisation should largely absorb the scale. Watcher running.

P018 period means: 25.24, 26.49, 26.29, 26.66, 29.19, 31.88, 32.45, 32.48, 39.88 (p9 at 450,498 decisions, n=51). Best 39.88 ≥ 39.4, so the 500k rule is passed and the run continues to 1M. Invalid 10/741. anon+shmem 57.6G.
Period 10 at 500,747 decisions: 44.88 (n=48). This is the first period above the 43.09 success bar, and above every 0.999 control (best: P016 a1 43.09). Success needs period 11 > 43.09 as well.

SUCCESS bar met: period 10 44.88 (n=48), period 11 46.02 (n=46) at 550,804 decisions, both > 43.09. Invalid 12/837. Run continues to its 1M budget; the verdict, ADR 0013 supersession and R2D2 discount get recorded when it ends. n=1 against 3 controls; the horizon change is confounded with the reward scale.

Developer approved continuing P018 from 1M to 2M decisions as a separately labelled extension. The 1M result stays the protocol result. Reason: the level has held at ~46-53 for p11-p18 (p18 52.78 best), and DreamerV3 has broken plateaus twice before. Checking that the run can resume past its budget before it reaches 1M.

Budget reached. Period 20 at 1,000,900 decisions: 59.10 (n=39), the best period. Period means p14-p20: 46.45, 49.43, 51.53, 46.67, 52.78, 57.38, 59.10. Resume point written: latest.pt plus 1,001,689 replay items (10.67 GB). Pre-registered final evaluation now running. The 1M to 2M extension follows once the stage exits. Behaviour at p18-19: DA 84% of spend from wave 30 on, median death wave 61, 59% of runs reach 60+, 96% of deaths still hold affordable cash (scratchpad m3-p018/behaviour.md).

Pre-registered final evaluation at 1M ran (segments/1/summary.json, pre_registered_final): n=30 (29 valid; 1 mask_legal_rejected), mean final wave 63.28, sd 9.04, range 40-75. It used the 1,010,001-decision weights: in-flight episodes overshoot by at most one per actor. Cleanup checks passed on all 7 instances. Extension to 2M launched in place at 20:19Z (unit m3-p018-ext-20261001T201904Z, segment 2). Replay restored. Period 21: 61.97 (n=33).

Extension period means p21-p35: 61.97, 50.65, 62.69, 59.52, 59.26, 56.27, 55.88, 66.13, 63.54, 54.88, 48.81, 52.32, 60.42, 54.74, 43.69. The level after 1M is ~57, and the last 8 periods trend down. A behaviour check of p30-31 found the same purchase mix (DA ~80%) with a fatter lower tail, not a strategy change. The protocol result is unchanged (1M final evaluation 63.28).

Extension ended early at 1,802,065 decisions (2026-10-02 06:31 CEST), exit 1. Cause: host memory pressure. systemd-oomd killed org.gnome.Shell at 06:31:02 (user@1000.service pressure 72% > 50%). All 7 bridges reported BridgeDisconnectedError at 06:31:04, all actors were withdrawn, and the run raised RunPortError. Cleanup ok. The resume point was saved at 1,802,065 with 1,803,510 replay items (19.2 GB). Replay grows ~10.7 GB per 1M items. Scope anon+shmem was 70.7G at p36. Host rebooted 08:12. Last period p36 66.54 (n=35). 2M not reached, so no 2M final evaluation.

Resumed at 1,802,065 toward 2M, 08:23 CEST. Unit m3-p018-ext2-20261002T062327Z in towerrl.slice. Protection: the slice has ManagedOOMMemoryPressure=kill at 30%/10s, so oomd kills the run before the session's 50%/20s rule can reach the shell; scope MemoryHigh 88G, MemoryMax 100G. Cause of the 06:31 death: the emulators use -gpu host and died with 'X connection to :0 broken' when the shell was killed. Period 37: 54.42 (n≈40).

2M final evaluation (segments/3/summary.json, pre_registered_final, checkpoint decisions-2007970-v1003285.pt): n=30, 0 invalid, mean 55.77, sd 19.79. Bimodal: 6/30 died at waves 20-23 (the #80 wall); the other 24 averaged 64.4 (range 31-74). 1M evaluation: 63.28 sd 9.04, min 40. Difference -7.5, Welch SE ~4.0, ~1.9 SE: training to 2M did not improve the policy, and early collapses returned. Cleanup checks passed on all 7. Next: record P018 in experiments.md.

Recorded in 362321c. The pre-registered bar was met (p10-11: 44.88, 46.02 > 43.09). 1M final evaluation: 63.28 (sd 9.04, n=29 valid). Extension to 2M (developer-approved, not protocol): final evaluation 55.77 (sd 19.79), so training to 2M didn't help. Caveats: n=1, confounded with reward scale; correction recorded that P017 had also switched to DA by its p10. ADR 0019 supersedes ADR 0013's value: γ 0.997 per game-second for both learners.
